limitations.detail: Transactions that failed on mainnet are observed but not replayed, so no failure path is represented.
Interactions that create a token account are outside the exact historical contract and are excluded.
Transactions crediting an account that stays below its rent-exempt minimum are accepted by mainnet and refused by the replay runtime, so they are excluded. Tip accounts are the common case.
A v0 message that actually resolves addresses through a lookup table is outside the replay contract and is excluded, so any interaction shape that requires one is unrepresented.
